_comment: Per-subject config for the paper crop pipeline. Copy to content/<subject>/syllabus.json. outcomes[].code is the CLOSED vocabulary for syllabusRefs (AI tagging validates against it). types is the full question-type taxonomy (structural mc/short/extended plus subject-specific ones). sections describes the exam structure so detection and the skill know what to expect. notes holds layout quirks (how marks print, what answer lines look like).
subject: <subject-slug>

outcomes.description: what the outcome says a student does
